I've sat on both sides of the brief.

I've written the brief as the brand, and answered it as the creator deciding whether that brand was worth my audience's trust. That double view is where the rest comes from: eight years testing ideas out loud on my own platform, then putting them to work for a ₹400+ Cr family business, a D2C brand I co-founded, and close to 50 brand collaborations.

Four years at KPMG in between taught me to read a business the way analysts do: investor perception, disclosure gaps, what genuinely moves the needle for a company's stakeholders. It's an unusual route into marketing. I think that's the point.

The constant across all of it is sustainability. It is what I built an audience around, what Azure Finds existed to prove, and what I now lead on as Sustainability Coordinator at ISB. I have found it lands hardest when it feels personal, culturally rooted and easy to act on.

What I do

Wireworks · Div. of Infiniti Power · Jul 2025–Apr 2026
Organic LinkedIn growth in under 12 months
4×

How a 400+ crore family business became a genuine hiring channel on a zero-rupee media budget

Context

A 27-year-old IT solutions firm serving Fortune 500 clients across network cabling, AV solutions and data centre infrastructure. All the raw material for a strong employer brand was already there in the client list and the tenure. The opportunity was to give it a public voice.

Approach

Competitive benchmarking against comparable B2B/industrial brands, algorithm-informed content strategy, and city-level role-specific hiring carousels tailored to actual open roles.

Execution

Consistent 7–8 post/week cadence, internal stakeholder activation to seed early engagement, and a parallel 2,000+ member WhatsApp employer-branding community built from referral loops.

Results

Followers grew several-fold organically; engagement lifted to 20%+, with hiring carousels hitting 35–40%; by the time I handed over, LinkedIn was driving roughly a fifth of total hires.

Azure Finds · Co-founder · Jan 2021–Dec 2023
Gross merchandise value across 2,000+ transactions
₹10L+

Building a pre-loved fashion brand out of an Instagram DM list, and making personalisation the reason people stayed

Context

A growing Indian appetite for fashion with a second life, an Instagram account, and a thesis worth testing: that resale could feel considered rather than transactional.

Approach

Instagram-first acquisition through DMs, story polls and flash sales, with personalisation (handwritten notes, tailored recommendations) as the reason customers came back.

Execution

Owned sourcing, curation, pricing, and fulfilment end to end; built a 150+ supplier network through outreach and inbound interest; A/B tested content formats for conversion.

Results

4,000+ followers, 500+ active customers, 2,000+ transactions, and a 30%+ uptick in repeat orders directly tied to the personalization strategy.

Instagram community built from zero, over eight years
13K+

Eight years on the creator side of brand campaigns, and what that teaches you about the brand side

Context

Started posting about thrifted fashion in 2018 and moved fully into sustainable fashion and lifestyle content in 2020, making it one of India's earlier dedicated sustainability platforms.

Approach

Trust-first, platform-native storytelling over polish, and early adoption of new formats (Trial Reels, Edits app, broadcast channels) ahead of mainstream brand adoption. Alongside the paid work, Thrift Radar Weekly runs as a recurring series pointing people to where to buy second-hand clothing.

Execution

300+ posts across 8 years, and close to 50 paid and gifted brand collaborations run end to end: brief, production, performance reporting. Selected as 1 of 10 creators nationally for Taneira's sustainability campaign with Goonj, telling the story of pre-loved sarees given a second life through Goonj's Exchange, Elevate and Empower initiative.

Results

13K+ Instagram, 70K+ Pinterest, and engagement running 3 to 5% above industry benchmark across partnerships. The Taneira film was reposted by both Taneira and Goonj, carrying it well past my own following. One Reel reached 922K views and 19K shares.

ISB · Operations & Sustainability Council · IT, LRC & Sustainability Coordinator
Donors at a blood drive run with the Net Impact Club
100+

Turning a year-long council role into changes that outlast the cohort

Context

Councils at ISB run for one year, so the sustainability work that sticks is the work that becomes part of how campus operates rather than a one-off event.

Approach

Go after defaults and procurement, the quiet decisions that keep applying long after the people who made them have graduated.

Execution

Researched and proposed a campus-wide switch to biodegradable scrubbers and plant-based detergents, and piloted a reusable cup system with the Student Life Council to replace single-use plastic at cohort events.

Results

A blood donation drive with the Net Impact Club that brought in 100+ donors, and proposals built to be picked up and carried forward by the council that follows.

Underneath all of it: B.Com (Hons) from Lady Shri Ram College for Women, then four years at KPMG's CFO Finance Advisory practice, covering investor relations and business consulting for large-cap clients. That is the analytical layer every campaign above was built on. Instagram metrics verified independently via a claimed Qoruz creator profile.

I have been to 25 countries before turning 25, and spent more of that time underwater than on land. Scuba and snorkelling are the closest thing I have to a reset button, and they are also where I learned that the interesting things are rarely on the surface.

On campus I play pickleball, table tennis, basketball and a genuinely average game of squash. A professor who taught us frisbee once explained that the sport treats its Spirit of the Game trophy as seriously as the winner's trophy. That has stayed with me longer than most things I have been taught about strategy: how you play counts as much as whether you win.

The through line, if there is one, is that I like building things with other people and I like doing it well enough to be proud of how it happened.
